video.title: AI欧腐《他的谎言，带我遇见真爱/His Lie Led Me to True Love》
video.desc:
When art prodigy Julian fakes amnesia after an accident, his cheating boyfriend Chase claims campus heir and star quarterback Roman is Julian's real lover. Julian plays along to expose the betrayal, unaware Roman has loved him for years.

艺术天才Julian意外受伤后，故意假装失忆。没想到，出轨的男友Chase竟谎称校园继承人、明星四分卫Roman才是朱利安真正的恋人。
为了揭穿背叛，Julian决定将计就计，配合这场谎言。可他并不知道，Roman早已爱了他许多年。
